title: MCP Server Configuration
description: Configuration for a single [MCP server](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) in Claude Code. Supports stdio (local process), HTTP (streamable HTTP transport), and SSE (server-sent events) server types.

x-lintel.catalogDescription: MCP server configuration for Claude Code.

StdioServer.description: A stdio-based MCP server that runs as a local child process. Claude Code launches the command and communicates over stdin/stdout using the [MCP stdio transport](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/concepts/transports#stdio). Use `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` for plugin-relative paths.

type.description: Transport type. Optional for stdio servers — if `type` is omitted and `command` is present, stdio is assumed.

command.description: Executable to run (must be in `PATH` or an absolute/relative path).

args.description: Command-line arguments for the server process.

env.description: Environment variables set when starting the server. Values support `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process.

HttpServer.description: A remote MCP server using the [streamable HTTP transport](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/concepts/transports#streamable-http). Claude Code connects to the server over HTTP/HTTPS.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server endpoint.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include with requests (e.g. for authentication).

SseServer.description: A remote MCP server using the [SSE (server-sent events) transport](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/concepts/transports#http-with-sse). Claude Code connects to the server over HTTP/HTTPS with SSE for server-to-client messages.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server SSE endpoint.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include with requests (e.g. for authentication).
